principle: Splitting and merging unit state is deterministic conservation, never a reroll. A neutral split changes organization, not personnel quality. Selection may change child composition only when a real selection action with criteria, authority and time is persisted.

neutral_split.headcount: Requested child integer counts must be positive and sum exactly to the parent live personnel claim.
neutral_split.continuous_capability: For an unselected aggregate split, every child initially inherits the parent capability mean and spread vectors. This preserves the represented population distribution without inventing arbitrary better/worse children. Later training, casualties, replacements, service or explicit selection may make children diverge.
neutral_split.categorical_integer_state: For injuries, ranks, condition bands, equipment issue quantities, ammunition lots, mounts/animals and other conserved integer categories, allocate proportionally by child headcount using deterministic largest remainder. Equal remainders tie-break by stable child unit ID, never model preference.
neutral_split.named_members: Named exact/individual-lite members are not sampled from an aggregate distribution. If the parent contains named members, their destination must be explicitly specified by lawful order/source substructure or deterministically preserved by an existing membership claim; never duplicate or silently move them.
neutral_split.morale_fatigue_experience: Children inherit parent aggregate values at the split instant unless exact conserved substate is already tracked. Splitting never heals fatigue/injuries or raises experience/morale.
neutral_split.cohesion: A split may retain parent cohesion only where the child follows an already-practiced substructure. Creating a genuinely new organization may apply a non-positive integration/familiarity adjustment. Splitting can never increase cohesion for free.
neutral_split.equipment: Initial split partitions the parent's actually held/issued equipment claims; a child targeting a different standard then enters refit and consumes separate real stock/time. The split itself does not conjure the new loadout.
neutral_split.lineage: ID continuity is deterministic. If the split isolates a specified subset from a residual parent population, the residual child retains the parent unit ID and every isolated child receives a new stable ID. If there is no distinguished residual child, the largest child retains the parent ID; exact personnel ties use the lowest stable child ordinal/ID. If the player/institution explicitly dissolves the parent into an entirely new organization, no child retains the parent ID and the parent ID is retired. The transaction receipt records the continuity rule, before/after IDs, and parent lineage for every child.
neutral_split.derived_data: Invalidate/rebuild every child full capability derivative and battle kernel after a state-changing partition. Derived caches never choose the partition.

explicit_selection.rule: A request such as veteran company, best archers, strongest fighters, qualified medics or fastest riders is not a neutral split.
requirements: inspection/records or another valid evidence source
deterministic selection method or registered deterministic draw where genuinely uncertain
explicit_selection.result: Recalculate every affected child distribution from the selected and remainder populations. The weighted recombination must match the pre-selection parent population apart from separately paid/elapsed changes.
explicit_selection.anti_exploit: Repeated split/merge cannot fish for favorable child statistics. No model-variation sampling is permitted.

largest_remainder.formula: quota_i = total_category_count * child_personnel_i / parent_personnel; base_i=floor(quota_i); distribute remaining integers to highest fractional remainders; exact ties sort by stable child unit ID ascending.
largest_remainder.invariant: sum(child_category_counts) == parent_category_count for every conserved category.

merge.preconditions: Same troop type; ownership/authority permits merge; intended loadout standard is compatible; doctrine/training/command differences are explicitly resolved.
merge.morale_fatigue: Use personnel-weighted current state unless a more exact underlying distribution is owned. Merge never resets either.
merge.cohesion: Start no higher than the personnel-weighted source cohesion and apply any real integration penalty required by doctrine/familiarity/history. Real joint training/time may later restore it.
merge.experience_history: Pool experience by personnel weighting while preserving source lineage/service history. Do not erase veteran history or duplicate experience receipts.
merge.derived_data: Recompute full aggregate capability and derived battle kernel from the merged authoritative state.

required_evidence: parent-ID continuity mode and continuity child
receipts.idempotency: A transaction ID may settle once. Replaying the same ID must not create a second split/merge.
